name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 6 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2026-03-28, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.50 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
